verdict.rationale: Zero is an AI email client, and recurring scheduled workflows such as automations or recurring triage are a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence covers only one-off MCP actions (send, archive, label, bulk delete) and AI features like auto-categorization. Nothing documents a scheduler, cron-style recurring jobs, or saved workflows that run on a schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
